brief.headline: Cut the price by ₹14.26 L/year to match Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG — you're paying 13.6% over our best rate for the same Dextrose.

priceAsk.summary: Ask them to match Sayaji Industries' ₹66.48/KG for Dextrose Anhydrous IP, down from our current ₹75.51/KG
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹66.48/KG to Sayaji for the same material — you're 13.6% higher. The open market typical band is ₹66–73/kg, so Sayaji's price sits right in the fair range. Your current rate is at the top end and we need you at the lower end to stay competitive.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no change needed here

brief.financialLeverage: They're big — ₹556.14 Cr in sales — and we're tiny at ₹59.65 L (0.11% of their business), so on our own we have almost no pull. But they're growing fast (42.6% a year) and want new orders, which gives us an opening. They keep about ₹3.50 of every ₹100 they sell (3.5% net margin), so they're not starved for cash but also can't afford to walk away from a commitment if we bundle more volume. The play: offer to lock in a year's worth of orders or add another material in return for hitting Sayaji's price.

evidence.point: We pay ₹75.51/KG; Sayaji charges ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose
Market asking price for Anhydrous Dextrose IP is ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg — our target sits in the typical band
They're growing sales by 42.6% per year — they want volume
We're only 0.11% of their ₹556.14 Cr revenue, so we need to bundle or play off an alternate to get leverage
evidence.figure: Our spend: ₹59.65 L; their revenue: ₹556.14 Cr; our share: 0.11%

evidence.point: Their health score is C (56/100) and debt-to-equity is 0.41x — stable but not rock-solid, so a credible second source adds pressure

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, ₹2437.35 Cr revenue, health B (68/100) — established dextrose supplier and a drop-in alternate to Sayaji; strong backup if Universal won't move.

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist, ₹842.97 Cr revenue, health C (52/100) — growing capacity in dextrose; worth an RFQ to sharpen the price.

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore wet-miller, ₹365.39 Cr revenue, makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS (IV-fluid grade) — exact form match; health is weaker (D 27/100) so qualify their CoA before switching.

risks: We're 0.11% of their business — too small to matter alone, so they may say no unless we bundle more SKUs or commit a longer term.
Their health score is C (56/100), middling — pushing too hard without a qualified second source could leave us scrambling if they walk.
Sayaji is our best price today at ₹66.48/KG — if Universal won't match and we haven't locked Sayaji on contract, we risk losing that rate too.
The three alternates (Gulshan, Sanstar, Tirupati) are not yet qualified or priced — line up an RFQ with at least one before the meeting so the threat is real.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We want to grow our Dextrose order with you this year, but right now we're paying ₹75.51 and Sayaji gives us ₹66.48 for the same spec — can you match that price if we commit the volume?
